current_resource_gates.MODEL_CALLS: Require at least one enabled non-Tier-0 model route and an evidence-backed model-requiring work item.
current_resource_gates.ENGINEERING_CAPACITY: Require READY_FOR_ISOLATED_EXECUTION work whose execution mode is ISOLATED_SYNTHETIC_TEST or an explicitly verified engineering demand.
current_resource_gates.TESTING: Require an executable isolated test/regression plan rather than generic internal activity.
current_resource_gates.HUNTER_RUNS: Allow capability-evidence-gap uncertainties suitable for public Hunter search.
current_resource_gates.ART_PRODUCTION: Require an explicit art/asset uncertainty or experiment; product identity alone is insufficient.
current_resource_gates.HUMAN_REVIEW: Allow HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED plans; recommendation allocates attention, not approval.
current_resource_gates.API_INFRASTRUCTURE: Require an approved infrastructure need or enabled provider/runtime requirement.
current_resource_gates.CASH: Require a human-approved concrete resource pool and governance receipt; normalized allocator cannot move money.

invariants: Every recommendation retains the source uncertainty component vector and evidence references.
No single opaque score or weighted cross-resource score is used.
Verified external outcomes and external-validation uncertainties outrank internal activity for relevant resources.
Normalized shares are advisory proportions, not claimed hours, dollars, API calls or other real quantities.
Unallocated share remains HOLD rather than being forced into low-value activity.
MODEL_CALLS cannot allocate while checked-in non-Tier-0 providers are disabled.
CASH cannot allocate from the checked-in normalized plan and always remains human-governed.
Human-review allocation is attention priority only and never constitutes approval.
Engineering/testing/art resources are not allocated merely because a project exists.
Allocator output cannot grant ACT, deploy, send communication, move money or execute downstream work.
